Class ClientSearchTableModel

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.table.AbstractTableModel
be.henallux.project.view.ClientSearchTableModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TableModel
public class ClientSearchTableModel extends AbstractTableModel
Table model used to display a list of ClientSupplier instances in a ClientSearchTable through a JTable.

It provides an action column ("See") used by the UI to trigger navigation to a detailed client view.

The model is read-only: all modifications must be done by replacing the underlying data via setClients(List).

  • Constructor Details

    • ClientSearchTableModel

      public ClientSearchTableModel(List<ClientSupplier> clients)
      Creates a table model used to display client search results in a JTable.

      This model stores the list of ClientSupplier displayed inside the ClientSearchTable.

      The table content is entirely driven by the provided list and is intended to be refreshed through setClients(List) after each search operation.

      Parameters:
      clients - the initial list of ClientSupplier displayed in the table
      See Also:

    • setClients

      public void setClients(List<ClientSupplier> clients)
      Replaces the currently displayed client list.

      After updating the data source, the JTable is refresh by AbstractTableModel.fireTableDataChanged().

      This method is typically called after a new search performed by ClientSearchTable.onSearchClick().

      Parameters:
      clients - the new list of ClientSupplier to display

    • getValueAt

      public Object getValueAt(int row, int col)
      Returns the value displayed for a specific table cell.

      The returned value depends on the requested column and formatted information from the corresponding ClientSupplier.

      • Identity and contact information
      • Client registration date
      • Fidelity card information
      • Address and locality information
      • Action label for the detail view button

      Missing values (null) are replaced with "-".

      Parameters:
      row - the row index corresponding to the displayed ClientSupplier
      col - the column index identifying the requested field
      Returns:
      the value displayed inside the requested table cell
      See Also:
      • ClientSupplier
